choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: the manuscript reports cosine similarity and L2 distance together without naming either primary or main, provides no specification or participant-level statistics that favor one, and the remaining rules do not distinguish these metrics of the same lyric-output contrast. The linked OSF supplements and related preregistration could not be accessed, so no external priority could be confirmed.
